# Learning exercise fixture

This isolated workspace is for a real Copilot Local acceptance request. It contains no personal NeoLearning files, provider credentials or completed user work.

Linked-list exercises belong under `02_contiguous_vs_linked_structures/`. Choose a suitable problem that is absent from the section. A useful exercise includes a readable Cornell research note, practical questions with separate answers, and C11/C++17 implementations with executable boundary-case checks. Existing files must be preserved. Use the repository tools and compilers that are actually available; do not claim unexecuted checks.

This document defines the fixture's product conventions, not an orchestration protocol. The user request remains ordinary prose.
